# Golden Test Fixtures

This directory contains committed golden trees for per-target render tests in
`internal/render/golden_test.go`.  Each subdirectory mirrors the filesystem
output produced by the render pipeline (`writeRendered`) for the corresponding
harness target.

## Layout

Each golden tree (`<target>/`) contains the expected filesystem layout under
the rendered skill directory:

```
golden/<target>/
  SKILL.md            — Rendered SKILL.md with target-specific frontmatter
  .symskills.json     — Managed-install marker (source hash)
  scripts/helper.sh   — Copied support file from the fixture
  agents/openai.yaml  — Codex metadata (target=codex only)
```

## Origin

- The fixture source lives at `internal/render/testdata/source/`.
- Goldens are regenerated by running:

    go test ./internal/render/... -run TestGoldenRender -update

- Each golden tree was produced by `RenderTarget` → `writeRendered` and
  committed so CI can detect regressions in the render output.

## Harness contracts (install paths)

The resolved install paths are derived from the per-target name (which may
differ from the fixture's source name via target aliases) and the target's
contract in `internal/install.InstallPath`:

| Target      | Global install path                          | Project install path                   |
|-------------|----------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------|
| opencode    | ~/.config/opencode/skills/<name>             | <project>/.opencode/skills/<name>      |
| claude      | ~/.claude/skills/<name>                      | <project>/.claude/skills/<name>        |
| codex       | ~/.agents/skills/<name>                      | <project>/.agents/skills/<name>        |
| hermes      | ~/.hermes/skills/symaira/<name>              | <project>/.hermes/skills/<name>        |
| antigravity | ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills/<name>      | <project>/.agents/skills/<name>        |
| openclaw    | ~/.openclaw/skills/<name>                    | <project>/.agents/skills/<name>        |

Antigravity and OpenClaw global paths follow their official docs
(antigravity.google/docs/skills and docs.openclaw.ai/tools/skills); both
harnesses also read `<project>/.agents/skills` for workspace/project skills,
the same directory Codex uses at project scope.
